technical.summary: Strong trend structure with ADX confirmation and new highs, but overbought conditions across multiple oscillators and declining momentum (RSI/Stoch not rising) create pullback risk; moderate entry quality with elevated caution.

fundamental.summary: FSLR shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 99 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signals; congressional activity is stale (431+ days old), market fear/greed is neutral, and news data unavailable.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (255.5) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 99 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong trend structure (ADX confirmation, Hull flip, 20-day new high) with price near support (163.14) offers technical entry geometry if macro headwinds ease.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators across RSI/Stoch/Williams%R with declining momentum, zero fundamental conviction, crisis-level VIX, inverted yield curve, and earnings event risk in 99 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical trend structure is intact with ADX confirmation and new 20-day highs, but entry quality is compromised by overbought oscillators and declining momentum that signal pullback risk.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (255.5), inverted yield curve, and earnings event in 99 days create severe macro headwinds that can trigger sharp reversals despite technical strength; overbought conditions across RSI/Stoch/Williams%R increase probability of mean reversion.
